author: NivdeFly
quote: Replayed this countless times, even 100 percented it once. Only game i've tried to speedrun. The movement is the best i've seen in a game ever. The worlds are unique and have fantastic music.

author: NivdeFly
quote: Almost everything about this game is great, from the story to the music. If I had to pick out a single flaw it would be the art.

author: NivdeFly
quote: This is the best piece of media I have ever consumed. I dont think anything will ever top this to be honest. The music is incredible. The characters are fantastic. And the story is filled with mysteries and interesting plotlines.

author: NivdeFly
quote: Exeeded my expectations by a long shot. Loved this from start to finish. The upgrades and items are incredible. The soundtrack is amazing.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: NivdeFly
quote: Incredible masterpiece that founded and inspired the games we have today. Amazing worldbuilding and soundtrack.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: NivdeFly
quote: Another realistic slop game from a non consumer AAA company. No online, 30 fps, buggy mess, after 13 years is crazy work. 100% bought critic score too. Nominated to goty before even releasing to the public.
